- **Analysis:**
  - `is_suffix_stable()` returns `True` for `Arrival()`, `False` for `ByKey(K)`, and raises `OrderingError` for unknown variants.
  - Probed multi-op folds (`Upsert`, `Collect`, `Avg`, `Max`, `Min`):
    - Under `Arrival()`, `Spec.replay_from(checkpoint, suffix)` produces byte-identical output to cold `Spec.replay(all_records)`, even when incoming facts are backdated on event time (`ts`).
    - Under `ByKey(K)`, any backdated record inserts into the middle of the sorted stream, causing suffix replay on a held checkpoint to diverge from cold replay.
  - There are no holes in the dispatch licensing rule.
